newsitem.title: ITALY: Weekend rainstorms help drought-hit northern Italy.
newsitem.headline: Weekend rainstorms help drought-hit northern Italy.

text.p: Heavy rainstorms throughout northern Italy on Sunday have helped to lessen some of the effects of months of drought, the Central Office for Agrarian Ecology said.
An official of the Rome-based state monitoring agency said rainstorms were registered throughout the country from Rome northwards.
In the northwest city of Turin, nine millimetres of rain fell, the total so far for the whole month of April.
The Office did not have complete rainfall details immediately available.

The Italian air force meteorological office forecast for Monday a depression over central regions with a cloud system moving southwest. Northeast regions could see some scattered showers with some rainstorms in the south of Italy and in Sicily.
Temperatures were seen falling slightly in the south but stationary in the centre and north.
On Tuesday, scattered showers were likely to affect most parts of the country.
